intro: Legacy of the Aspects is an ancient tome hidden deep within the Dor'Danil Barrow Den in southern Ashenvale. Retrieved during a Horde trial of the intellect, the volume contains essential lore concerning the Great Aspects that shaped ancient Azeroth.

p: While earlier trials set forth by tauren elders test physical endurance and resolve, the pursuit of Legacy of the Aspects is designed to challenge the mind. Tasked by Braug Dimspirit at the entrance to the Talondeep Path in the Stonetalon Mountains, an aspirant must delve into the haunted barrow dens of Dor'Danil. Guarded by the restless spirits of fallen druids and the vicious creatures that slew them, the ancient text rests upon a stone pedestal. Claiming the volume is only the first step; the seeker must commit its contents to memory before relinquishing the book, as they are tested on its historical lessons.
